title: SAKURA: Serving Attention Key-Value State Under Rate Adaptation for Private Image Editing on Phones
abstract: arXiv:2610.29733v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion transformers are widely used in image-editing services. To preserve both efficiency and privacy, existing systems commonly rely on cloud-device collaboration. Keeping request-specific inference on the device avoids sending personal images and prompts to the cloud. These workloads often use common templates, such as in face swapping and virtual try-on, enabling KV state to be precomputed and reused across requests. However, this reusable state is large and scales with the number of templates, making it impractical to store all of them on mobile devices. Storing them in the cloud addresses this capacity issue, but cache transfer is placed onto the inference path and can even be slower than on-device computation, especially under fluctuating mobile networks. translated_title: SAKURA：面向手机端隐私图像编辑的速率自适应注意力键值状态服务
translated_abstract: 扩散Transformer被广泛应用于图像编辑服务中。为了同时兼顾效率和隐私，现有系统通常采用云-端协同的方式。将针对特定请求的推理保留在设备端进行，可以避免将个人图像和提示词发送到云端。这类工作负载通常使用通用模板，例如换脸和虚拟试穿，这使得KV状态可以被预先计算并在不同请求之间复用。然而，这种可复用的状态体积庞大，且随模板数量的增加而增长，因此将所有模板状态都存储在移动设备上并不现实。将它们存储在云端虽然可以解决容量问题，但缓存传输被置于推理路径上，甚至可能比设备端的计算还要慢，尤其是在移动网络波动的情况下。我们提出了SAKURA，这是一种云边协同架构，能够在带宽预算约束下向移动设备交付可复用的注意力状态。该系统首先利用细粒度的token重要性（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SAKURA提出了一种云边协同架构，通过速率自适应机制在带宽预算内向手机传输可复用的注意力KV状态，从而在保护隐私的前提下实现高效的端侧图像编辑。
en_tdlr: SAKURA is a cloud-edge architecture that delivers reusable attention KV states to phones under a bandwidth budget through rate adaptation, enabling efficient and privacy-preserving on-device image editing.
